{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
non_qa_sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter only completed orders (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = non_qa_sales[non_qa_sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = completed_orders.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference: email - paid_search
diff_rate = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Print the necessary numbers for evidence
print("Conversion rate for email:", conversion_rates['email'])
print("Conversion rate for paid_search:", conversion_rates['paid_search'])
print("Difference (email - paid_search):", diff_rate)

# Return the values for submission
conversion_rates, diff_rate"}
